episodes.title: 2026 Tribeca- Tim Blake Nelson stars in "The Leader"
episodes.description:
Our next film we are excited to shine a spotlight on for this years 2026 edition of The Tribeca Film festival, is the project, "The Leader" starring Vera Farmiga and Tim Blake Nelson, alongside an ensemble cast of very talented and excited cast members to portray this story, which is based on true events.

Synopsis: In 1997, thirty-nine members of the American cult known as "Heaven's Gate" committed the largest mass suicide to ever take place on American soil. This is their story.
